[[B]]

**Explanation:** Assistant B demonstrates a superior coaching approach by recognizing that effective conflict resolution requires understanding the specific context, root causes, and history of the situation. Instead of offering generic, one-size-fits-all advice (as Assistant A does), Assistant B asks targeted clarifying questions to gather the necessary details to provide tailored, actionable guidance. This inquiry-based method aligns with professional coaching standards and is far more likely to yield a helpful outcome for the user.
